audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer has Neeko's slots wrong in three places. It calls Blooming Burst her W ('her W Blooming Burst', 'comboed with E Tangle-Barbs and W Blooming Burst'), and it calls the clone a passive ('her only escape is passive Inherent Glamour disguise and a slow W', 'Use passive clone to bait a bad engage').
audit.why: Riot's kit: Blooming Burst is Q (9s at rank 1, 800 range, seed that blooms again on hitting a champion). Shapesplitter is W (16s at rank 1) — that is the clone, and it also gives bonus magic damage every third attack plus move speed. Inherent Glamour is the passive disguise, which breaks when she takes immobilizing crowd control or casts a damaging spell — so a landed Disdain (E) flip strips a disguised Neeko outright.
audit.corrected: Blooming Burst is Q, Shapesplitter (W) is the clone and the move-speed step, Inherent Glamour is the disguise and your E flip breaks it. Tangle-Barbs (E) is 12s at rank 1 and gets larger, faster and longer-rooting if it passes through a champion — so never stand behind a minion it can grow on.
